title: What Scripture Actually Means by Speak the Truth in Love
caption:
Most men only manage half of Ephesians 4:15. Some only know truth: blunt, exacting, sharp with everyone. Some only know love: soft on everything, especially the sin sitting right in front of them, because naming it might cost the friendship.

Truth without love reads as contempt. Love without truth reads as cowardice. Scripture never asked you to pick a lane.

Go hardest on your own sin first. A man who's ruthless with his own sin earns the right to speak into someone else's. Then, when a brother's drifting, say the hard sentence before it becomes a habit. Privately, and first. Silence feels like kindness. It's actually the coward's version of love.

Truth spoken in love ends with an open hand, not a slammed one.

#faith #brotherhood #godlyman #christianmen #scripture
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
